procedure_title: Pad block and strap verification demo
instruction: Place the blue pad on the tray. Put the red block on the blue pad. Keep the block on the pad while wrapping the yellow strap around it.

steps.title: Place the pad
steps.instruction: Place the blue pad on the tray.
steps.source_span: Place the blue pad on the tray.

requirements.description: The blue pad is on the tray.
requirements.source_span: Place the blue pad on the tray.
requirements.vqa_question: Is the blue pad on the tray?
requirements.observation_hint: Show the pad and tray together after placement, including their boundaries.

steps.title: Place the block
steps.instruction: Put the red block on the blue pad.
steps.source_span: Put the red block on the blue pad.

requirements.description: The red block is on the blue pad.
requirements.source_span: Put the red block on the blue pad.
requirements.vqa_question: Is the red block on the blue pad?
requirements.observation_hint: Show the red block and blue pad after placement with the contact relationship visible.

steps.title: Wrap the strap
steps.instruction: Keep the block on the pad while wrapping the yellow strap around it.
steps.source_span: Keep the block on the pad while wrapping the yellow strap around it.

requirements.description: The block remains on the pad throughout wrapping.
requirements.source_span: Keep the block on the pad while wrapping the yellow strap around it.
requirements.vqa_question: Does the block remain on the pad throughout the wrapping action?
requirements.observation_hint: A continuous video must show the block-pad relationship from the start to the end of wrapping. A final image alone is insufficient.

requirements.description: The yellow strap is wrapped around the block.
requirements.source_span: wrapping the yellow strap around it
requirements.vqa_question: Is the yellow strap wrapped around the block?
requirements.observation_hint: Show the completed strap placement around the block, including the relevant sides; use unknown if occlusion prevents assessment.
